Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student in the SmartCalm Reports system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the student.

lastName.description: The last name of the student.

email.description: The email address of the student.

gradeLevel.description: The grade level of the student (e.g., '10th Grade').

major.description: The major or field of study for the student, if applicable.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the student's account is active.

Teacher.title: Teacher
Teacher.description: Represents a teacher or admin in the SmartCalm Reports system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Teacher entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the teacher.

lastName.description: The last name of the teacher.

email.description: The email address of the teacher.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DailyReport entity.

date.description: The date for which the report is recorded.

wakeUpTime.description: The time the student woke up.

studyStartTime.description: The time the student started studying.

studyEndTime.description: The time the student finished studying.

totalStudyMinutes.description: Total minutes studied on the report date.

sleepAmount.description: Total amount of sleep student got

disasterLevel.description: Slider from 1-10 indicating the students current mental status

minutesOfMobileUsage.description: Amount of time spent of the students mobile device

SubjectItem.title: SubjectItem
SubjectItem.description: Represents each subject that the student will be submitting a report for

id.description: Unique identifier for the SubjectItem entity.

topic.description: The specific topic that was studied

studyTime.description: Amount of time spent on the topic

totalTestQuestions.description: Total number of questions on the test

correctTestQuestions.description: Number of correct answers on the test

incorrectTestQuestions.description: Number of incorrect answers on the test

definition.description: Stores teacher profiles. The 'teacherId' is the Firebase Authentication UID.  Teachers can only manage their own profile.

params.name: teacherId

definition.description: Stores student profiles managed by a specific teacher. The 'teacherId' is the Firebase Authentication UID of the teacher. This structure allows easy listing of students managed by a teacher. Includes denormalized 'teacherId' for authorization independence.

params.name: teacherId
params.description: The UID of the teacher who manages this student.

params.name: studentId
params.description: The unique ID of the student.

definition.description: Stores daily reports for a specific student managed by a teacher.  The 'teacherId' and 'studentId' ensure proper data scoping. Includes denormalized 'teacherId' and 'studentId' for authorization independence.

params.name: teacherId
params.description: The UID of the teacher who manages this student.

params.name: studentId
params.description: The unique ID of the student.

params.name: dailyReportId
params.description: The unique ID of the daily report.

definition.description: Stores subject items for a specific daily report of a student managed by a teacher. The 'teacherId', 'studentId', and 'dailyReportId' ensure data scoping. Includes denormalized 'teacherId', 'studentId', and 'dailyReportId' for authorization independence.

params.name: teacherId
params.description: The UID of the teacher who manages this student.

params.name: studentId

params.name: dailyReportId
params.description: The unique ID of the daily report.

params.name: subjectItemId
params.description: The unique ID of the subject item.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to manage students and teachers, enabling teachers to add, edit, and manage student data. It leverages path-based ownership for managing student data under each teacher, facilitating easy querying and secure access. The structure ensures authorization independence by not relying on parent document data for child document access. QAPs are supported through structural segregation, as the teacher can manage their students, and students' daily reports and subject items are organized under their user ID, simplifying list operations within the scope of a user's data.
